title: Interest rate hedging of a fixed-rate loan portfolio (R)
summary: A complete R implementation covering rate scenario generation, swap and loan valuation, a bucketed hedging strategy and its validation. The hedge decision is threshold-based rather than automatic: hedge only where the economic spread is positive, with the threshold found by numerical optimisation.
evidence: short-rate models: CIR, CIR++ and Hull-White one-factor, admitting negative EUR rates
parallel Monte Carlo simulation of rate scenarios
vectorised swap pricer covering PV, par rate and MTM
loan present-value calculator with monthly cash flows and prepayments
maturity-bucket hedging with duration-matched notional allocation
full and partial hedges compared, backtested against real historical EUR curves
threshold-based hedge decision with parameters set by numerical optimisation
notes: This is the source system of the R-to-Java migration recorded in observed-controlled-migration. Harvested from the CV, which records no friction.
